classification: CONFIRMATORY read of the already-frozen, already-verified 2v2 Separated system. No training, no gradient step, no architecture change occurs under this record. Not PAPER-FAITHFUL.
authorized_by: Written under STANDARDIZED_2V2_SEPARATED_CROSSOVER_EXPLORATORY_SPEC.json#READING_RULE_exploratory (a PASS licenses a confirmatory spec on a fresh, disjoint n=128 sealed_confirmatory block), mirroring DEFEND_ATTACK_SPLIT_POLICY_A_V1_CONFIRMATORY_V1_SPEC.json at 4v4 and SCHOOL_PC_6V6_LOCKED_PIPELINE.json seeds.crossover_confirmatory at 6v6. SEED SPEND AWAITS THE PI's GO.
CANONICAL_DELTA_CONVENTION_locked: delta_A = V(pi_A, Pole A) - V(pi_B, Pole A); delta_B = V(pi_B, Pole B) - V(pi_A, Pole B); exactly as computed by eval_specialist_crossover_scaled.py and used by the exploratory pass

EVALUATION.gate: PASS iff mean(delta_A)>0 AND LCB95(delta_A)>0 AND mean(delta_B)>0 AND LCB95(delta_B)>0

CONTRACTS_before_seed_spend: C0 spec frozen and committed (tracked, no staged/unstaged changes)
C1 the three checkpoints equal their pins exactly
C2 the seed block is disjoint from every block listed under fresh_seeds_required
C3 read-only: no checkpoint is written, no model is selected; the three pinned finals are the only objects evaluated
C4 the dry-run passes: Rule 9 block free, both poles attest against the sealed 2v2 certification, frozen-attack sha matches
C5 the PI has given the go to spend this sealed_confirmatory block
EXPLICITLY_FORBIDDEN: retraining or modifying pi_D, the frozen pi_A or pi_B in this pass or in reaction to it
changing the splice, the role allocator, k, or any evaluation parameter from the exploratory pass
reusing the exploratory, training or certification seeds
re-running this label (one-shot; the evaluator refuses an existing output)
reporting this as the paper-faithful latent method
claim_boundary: A confirmatory replication, on fresh seeds at n=128, of the sealed n=64 exploratory crossover for the exact same frozen 2v2 Separated system. A PASS supports: under the one cross-scale methodology (same code; only N and k differ), the 2v2 Separated system shows the crossover. It says nothing about the distilled suite arms, which need their own dataset, distillation and evaluation stages.
